changelog: **Erasure reaches a stand-in lead's account contact (#3136):** erasing a MARKETING lead created on a generated `@import.local` stand-in (import, account events, pull connector) now also clears the real name, address, phone and position on the account it is linked to. `companyContactOps()` reads the lead's linked accounts (`User.companyId`, its relations', a live connector link's) and `leadIsAccountContact()` (`src/lib/companyContactErasure.ts`, unit-tested) decides per account — the stored address is the lead's own or the one its stand-in was derived from, else the stored name; an account whose contact is someone else is never touched. The real address goes through the shared `contactScrubOps()` and into the connector tombstone. Pinned by `e2e/erasure-stand-in-lead.spec.ts` (@smoke).

en: Erasing a lead now also removes that person's name, e-mail address and phone number from the account they were the contact of.
tr: Bir lead silindiğinde, muhatabı olduğu hesaptaki adı, e-posta adresi ve telefonu da artık siliniyor.
de: Beim Löschen eines Leads werden jetzt auch Name, E-Mail-Adresse und Telefonnummer der Person beim Account entfernt, dessen Kontakt sie war.
